issue.title: Lang-SDK task handlers: smaller follow-ups
issue.body:
Known limitations of the parse-time task-handler checks (#73978), each small:

- [ ] Send each Dag-parsing child only the cached answers for its own Dags; today it gets every cached answer in the bundles it can see.
- [ ] Probe a file's artifacts in parallel instead of one at a time.
- [ ] A stale Dag (removed from its file but not deleted) keeps its bindings, which keep its artifacts from the orphan sweep.
- [ ] On macOS, and for a runtime's own child processes, nothing kills what is left when the Dag-parsing child is killed.

---

Drafted with Claude Code (Opus 5.5).
